subject.title: feat(session): add named new and close chat commands

question: Should OpenClaw add chat-side `/close` and `/delete` archive commands now, and should this `/new --name` path write `label` while the canonical title migration is still open?
rationale: The parser bug is mechanical, but the destructive command surface and title/label contract are product and ownership choices that automation cannot safely decide.

options.title: Accept after repair and proof
options.body: Fix the catalog-backed `/new` parser regression, refresh current-head chat proof, then land if maintainers accept the destructive command surface and label/title alignment.

options.title: Split naming from deletion
options.body: Land only the explicit named `/new` part after title alignment and defer `/close`/`/delete` to a narrower session-management decision.

options.title: Wait for title migration
options.body: Pause this PR until the canonical title contract lands, then rebase the command implementation onto that field model.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Fix the catalog-backed `/new` parser regression, refresh current-head chat proof, then land if maintainers accept the destructive command surface and label/title alignment.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available owner signal for the existing `/new` reset/model behavior and current reset command path affected by the PR.
